Explain the difference between prediction and inference

Describe the bias-variance trade-off in one sentence

title: Topic 1: What Is Machine Learning?
text:
The core idea
We observe inputs \(X\) and an output \(Y\) and assume
\[
Y = f(X) + \varepsilon
\]
Machine learning is the set of methods for estimating \(f\).

title: Topic 1: What Is Machine Learning?
text:
A first look at data

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
x = rng.uniform(0, 10, 100)
y = 2 * np.sin(x) + x / 2 + rng.normal(0, 0.8, 100)

plt.scatter(x, y, alpha=0.6)
plt.xlabel("X"); plt.ylabel("Y")
plt.title("Noisy observations of an unknown f")
plt.show()
